info.description: Stream keys, Studio (video uploads included), live catalog and VODs. Get a token from identity-svc (http://localhost:8090/swagger/index.html → /auth/login) and paste "Bearer <accessToken>" into Authorize.
info.title: NexusLive stream-svc API

get.description: Broadcast recordings (source LIVE) and uploaded videos (source UPLOAD); source filters them.
get.summary: A channel's public VODs (Video tab), newest first

get.description: Positions below 5 s and VODs watched to within 10 s of the end are left out, like expired VODs.
get.summary: VODs the signed-in viewer has not finished, newest first

put.description: Clients send it at most every 15 s and when leaving. keepFurther=true keeps a further stored position (used to merge a browser's local progress after sign-in).
put.summary: Save the VOD position of the signed-in viewer

get.description: sort=viewers (default; trending is the same) orders by live viewers, then the most recent start; sort=newest by start. category is 1–30 category ids (comma-separated, from GET /v1/categories); tags must all match. channel is null for streams whose channel is unknown to stream-svc.
get.summary: Streams on air (LIVE and INTERRUPTED), mature ones included (isMature)

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED (category = INVALID, language = FORMAT, tags = TAG_COUNT, sort = ENUM, cursor = INVALID)

get.description: LIVE only (not INTERRUPTED), never 18+, by viewers then the most recent start. Not paged (nextCursor is null).
get.summary: Recommended live streams (Hero, "Live đề xuất", Guest sidebar)

get.description: status may be SCHEDULED (an announced occurrence: scheduleId, scheduledStartAt) or CANCELLED. vodId is null while the VOD is hidden, except for the channel owner.
get.summary: Stream detail (status, manifestUrl, vodId once the VOD is ready)

post.description: Guests may call it; send X-NXL-Anon-Id when you have one. Mature streams return mature.required=true and no manifestUrl until called again with acknowledgeMature=true (signed-in viewers are remembered per channel). With STREAM_HLS_SIGNING the manifestUrl is /hls/t/{expires}/{md5}/streams/{id}/master.m3u8, valid until expiresAt; a suspended channel answers 403 CHANNEL_SUSPENDED.
post.summary: Open a live (or ended) stream for playback

get.description: Counted on the tables directly. Followers and the next broadcast come from GET /v1/studio/channel/stats (channel-svc).
get.summary: Studio dashboard: the broadcast on air, the last 5 broadcasts and counts over the range

get.description: current is null when the channel is offline; health is the latest ingest report (5 s).
get.summary: Studio: the creator's channel, settings and the current broadcast

put.description: Applies to the next broadcast and to the one on air, if any. Title 1–140, at most 10 tags of ≤ 25 characters.

get.summary: Stream key status (never the key itself)

post.description: The key is returned only here, once. The previous key stops working immediately.
Moves the stream to ENDED; media-svc disconnects OBS and publishes the VOD.
Opens a session that takes the file in parts of partSize bytes (PUT …/parts/{n}, 1…partCount) until expiresAt. At most 3 uploads in flight (uploading or processing) and 10 sessions a day per channel.
post.summary: Studio: start uploading a video file

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED (fileName / contentType / title / description = LENGTH, sizeBytes = MIN, categoryId = INVALID, visibility = ENUM)

get.summary: Studio: an upload session and the parts received so far

delete.description: Drops the parts received so far. A session already aborted or expired is 204 too.

post.description: Assembles the parts and creates the video, PROCESSING until media-svc has transcoded it (follow it in GET /studio/vods). Calling it again on a COMPLETED session returns the same vodId.

put.description: The body is the part's bytes (application/octet-stream, at most 8 MiB): exactly partSize bytes for every part but the last, which carries the rest of the file. Sending a part again replaces it.
put.summary: Studio: send one part of the file

400.description: INVALID_PART (details.expectedBytes when the size is wrong)

get.description: Uploaded videos (source UPLOAD) are listed while PROCESSING (processing.percent) and when FAILED (failureReason, retryable); poll every 3 s while one is PROCESSING.
get.summary: Studio: the channel's VODs (READY, EXPIRED, PROCESSING and FAILED, hidden ones included), newest first

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED (visibility / status / source = ENUM, cursor = INVALID)

delete.description: Soft delete of a READY, EXPIRED, PROCESSING or FAILED VOD; media-svc then removes its files (vod.deleted.v1 carries playlistPrefix). A VOD already deleted is 404.

patch.description: A hidden VOD disappears from every public list, search and continue-watching; its URL is 404 for everyone but the owner. description, categoryId ("" removes it) and isMature apply to uploaded videos only (409 on a broadcast VOD); an uploaded video can change while READY or PROCESSING, a broadcast VOD while READY.
patch.summary: Studio: rename, hide or show a VOD; describe an uploaded video

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED (body = REQUIRED, title / description = LENGTH, visibility = ENUM, categoryId = INVALID)

409.description: INVALID_STATE (EXPIRED, FAILED, or an upload-only field on a broadcast VOD)

post.description: Only for an upload FAILED with retryable = true while its source file is still stored (3 days); the VOD goes back to PROCESSING.
post.summary: Studio: transcode a FAILED uploaded video again

409.description: INVALID_STATE (not FAILED, not retryable, broadcast VOD or source gone)

get.summary: Public VODs (READY, PUBLIC, not expired), newest first
Recommended VODs (newest public ones, never 18+); not paged

get.description: With a token, viewer.positionSec is the caller's saved position (null when never watched). A HIDDEN VOD is 404 except for its channel owner.

post.description: Same rules as /streams/{id}/playback; a VOD inherits the mature flag of its broadcast.

anonId.description: AnonID is echoed (or generated) for guests; the client stores it and sends it back in X-NXL-Anon-Id.

acknowledgeMature.description: AcknowledgeMature confirms the viewer is 18+; signed-in viewers are not asked again for the channel.

keepFurther.description: KeepFurther keeps the stored position when it is further (merging a browser's local progress on sign-in).

categoryId.description: CategoryID is a channel-svc category (GET /v1/categories); null = none.
CategoryID: absent or null removes the category (PUT replaces the settings).

scheduleId.description:
ScheduleID and ScheduledStartAt are set for a stream that comes from a schedule (status SCHEDULED, CANCELLED,
or LIVE / ENDED once attached).

viewerCount.description: ViewerCount is the number of people watching right now; null when unknown or not on air.

expiresAt.description: ExpiresAt is null for an uploaded video.

failureReason.description:
FailureReason and Retryable describe a FAILED upload (UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT, NO_VIDEO_STREAM, DURATION_TOO_LONG,
FILE_CORRUPT, TRANSCODE_FAILED, STORAGE_ERROR); Retryable allows POST /studio/vods/{id}/retry.

manifestUrl.description: ManifestURL is empty until the VOD is READY.

processing.description: Processing is set only while PROCESSING.

streamId.description: StreamID is null for an uploaded video.

contentType.description:
ContentType is video/mp4, video/quicktime, video/x-matroska, video/webm, or empty / application/octet-stream
(the extension decides).

fileName.description: FileName is shown to the creator only (never used as a path); .mp4, .mov, .mkv or .webm.

expiresAt.description: ExpiresAt is null for an uploaded video: it never expires.

publishedAt.description: PublishedAt is when the VOD became READY.

streamId.description: StreamID is null for an uploaded video.

viewer.description: Viewer is present only when the request carries a valid token.
